summary: Pickup restocks are now constant nationwide but most sell out in about a minute, and online orders still quote late January. Locally, American Dream restocked most this week and 9am is the peak hour, so act on the alert instantly.

items.title: Overnight NYC drops at Bay Plaza and Brooklyn on Oct 28
items.summary: Around 1:15 AM ET, Bay Plaza, Downtown Brooklyn and Williamsburg showed 256GB pickup stock; the Brooklyn units lasted about a minute. No NJ store was listed.

items.title: Oct 27 was the busiest restock day yet
items.summary: The tracker logged about 1,369 US store restocks on Tuesday, up from roughly 400 Monday. Half arrive between 9:30 and 10:40 AM local time, and a typical drop lasts one minute.

items.title: Manzana: mornings and Tuesdays are best
items.summary: Its latest US drop came at 11:51 AM ET on Oct 27, with pickup at just 5 of 269 stores. It sees most restocks from 9 AM to noon ET, most often on Tuesdays.

items.title: Apple confirms inner-screen defect on some Duos
items.summary: Apple acknowledged a folding-display problem on a small number of units; replacement stock is limited and some owners are waiting. No cause or fix timeline was given.

items.title: Report: Apple asks suppliers for 30% more Duos
items.summary: Taiwan's Economic Daily says Apple raised orders about 30%, lifting this year's outlook to 8-10 million units, though online ship dates still point to late January. Not confirmed by Apple.

items.title: Pickup reservations reopened for about five minutes
items.summary: US and Canada pickup slots appeared around 8:10 AM ET on Oct 24 and vanished roughly five minutes later; most stores never showed any.

items.title: Carriers quote December while Apple says late January
items.summary: Apple's online estimate sits near late January; Verizon and AT&T promised some units around mid-December, T-Mobile late December to January. Best Buy sells carrier-locked phones only.
